topic: The match where one bowler took all 10 wickets alone
hook: One man destroyed an entire team by himself.
script: One man destroyed an entire team by himself. In 1956, Jim Laker bowled 10 wickets in a single innings. Not 5. Not 8. All 10. The opposing team had 11 batsmen. He dismissed every single one. No other bowler in Test history has ever done it since. One spell. One man. Complete domination. Follow for cricket moments that still feel impossible.
